witness.branch: Traffic-side door left open during loading or unloading
witness.quote: A person shall not leave open a door on the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic longer than is necessary for immediate loading or unloading of passengers or cargo.
witness.reason: The loading task can include the driver leaving a traffic-side door open while another vehicle passes.
required_context: Actual passing-traffic paths establish the qualifying side.
Document passenger trajectories and occupancy changes or cargo handling and movement relative to the door-open interval.
Establish the closest side from actual passing-traffic paths and participant types.
Identify the person responsible for leaving the specified qualifying vehicle door open.
Observe opening, closing and any truncation without assuming a necessary duration.
Preserve necessary and immediate as unresolved judgments; elapsed time alone does not resolve them.
Retain opening and closing times, continuous open-state observations and any observation truncation.
Specify passenger or cargo loading activity and its timing relative to the door-open interval.
The selected driver is the person leaving the identified motor-vehicle door open.
witness.subject_reason: The driver personally leaves the door open; being a driver alone is insufficient.
